# Dr. Mohamad El Haress — Full Website Context

Dr. Mohamad El Haress, MD, FICS is a General Surgeon and Surgical Oncologist with international clinical and surgical training across Lebanon, the United States, France, India, Egypt and Lithuania. His training combines general and minimally invasive surgery with experience in complex surgical oncology, gastrointestinal surgery, colorectal surgery, breast surgery, and hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgery.

He completed his General Surgery residency at MGH in affiliation with the American University of Beirut. During residency, he pursued fellowship training in minimally invasive and laparoscopic surgery in New Delhi, India. His international training also included colorectal surgery experience at Alexandria University in Egypt and advanced hepatobiliary, pancreatic and liver transplant surgery training at Greater Paris University Hospitals (AP-HP) in France.

Dr. El Haress is currently completing the final year of his fellowship in Complex Surgical Oncology at the American University of Beirut Medical Center. His fellowship focuses on multidisciplinary management and surgical treatment of complex malignancies, particularly gastrointestinal, hepatobiliary, pancreatic, breast and other solid-organ cancers.

Professional memberships and qualifications displayed on the official website include Fellow of the International College of Surgeons, Associate Fellow of the American College of Surgeons, Member of the European Society of Surgical Oncology, Fundamentals of Laparoscopic Surgery program completion through SAGES, advanced trauma certification, and a Diploma in Healthcare Management for Physicians from Gates Group accredited by TRACCERT Canada.

- Hemorrhoids, anal fissure and fistula
- Benign GI, hepatobiliary and general surgical conditions
- Liver tumors and liver cancer
- Pancreatic tumors and pancreatic cancer
- Gallbladder and bile duct cancer
- Colon and rectal cancer
- Stomach and gastrointestinal cancers
- Breast tumors and breast surgery
- Endocrine tumors involving thyroid, parathyroid and adrenal glands
- Metastatic cancer surgery
- Debulking surgery and HIPEC
- Laparoscopic and minimally invasive surgery
